Per `lib/capability-probe.sh`, that resolves to **scratch mode**: no PR, no deploy, artifacts written to a tmp dir. Per the `/launch` SKILL, scratch mode runs only **Phase 1 (interpret-input)** and **Phase 4 (riff-prototypes)** — everything else (spec, GRASP, ux-migration, construction draft) needs `local` or `full` mode inside a real repo.

## Gallery — 4 variants at `/tmp/bassclef-launch-scratch/newsletter-signup/`

Luminary pick (in-turn, per `lib/luminary-pick.sh` catalog): **don-norman**, **steve-krug**, **luke-wroblewski** — a signup form mostly fails on affordance, friction, or mobile reach, so those three lenses cover the common failure points. Plus one Anthropic baseline (4 total, per medium tier's N=3+1).

| Variant | Lens | What it does differently |
|---|---|---|
| `variant-a-don-norman.html` | **Signifiers & feedback** | Bordered card form, strong focus ring, an explicit signifier line under the button ("clicking here sends the first issue"), visible inline confirmation on submit |
| `variant-b-steve-krug.html` | **Don't make me think** | One field, one button, centered, no value-prop bullets competing for attention — the pitch is the headline, nothing else to decide |
| `variant-c-luke-wroblewski.html` | **Mobile-first** | Single-column dark UI sized to a phone frame, label-above-input, full-width thumb-reach button pinned near the bottom |
| `variant-baseline-anthropic.html` | **Baseline** | Neutral two-column SaaS layout — copy left, card-form right — the champion-challenger control |

Open `index.html` in that folder to browse all four with back-nav, or any variant file directly.

## The plan

**Problem:** small-business owners want tech news that's relevant to running a business, not general tech news — one weekly email, five minutes, no fluff.

**Value prop:** *SMB Signal* — the weekly briefing that respects your Friday afternoon. New tools reviewed (not hyped), price changes that hit margins, one tip you can use before Monday.

**Scope for this page:** single email-capture field, one CTA, no account creation, no payment. Success = a subscriber record, a confirmation message, and a welcome email on the back end — nothing else blocks launch.

**What's NOT in this plan** because scratch mode stopped after Phase 4: formal use case, INVEST user stories, IA model, interaction design, GRASP responsibility matrix, and the buildable spec. Those come from Phases 5–9, which need `local` or `full` mode.

**Next step:** pick a variant (or ask me to refine), then re-run as `/launch medium "<same brief>" base=<variant-slug> --local` from inside a real git repo. That gets you the full spec + migration plan + a working localhost preview, without needing GitHub auth.
